public_contract.tree_interpretation: Flat ordered lookup components; not a unique theoretical word-formation tree or source offsets.

limitations: Required structural path judgments do not certify every generated candidate or contextual sense. Every unjudged addition retains its individual ID.
Source-pattern/headword inferences for 목걸이, 젖먹이 and 떠돌다 remain distinct from explicit primary segmentations. Annotated gold remains whole lexical/copy-exact corpus data.
Flat ordered compound components do not choose a unique theoretical derivation tree, invent character alignments, or license arbitrary compound segmentation.
Only these six native sense-2 forms are implemented. Other positive compounds 고기잡이/귀걸이 remain leads, not forbidden controls. All thirty sense-3 forms remain explicit review scope.
At the COV-022f source-capture stage, the 못난이 bound-noun conflict was an indexed primary excerpt and direct page retrieval failed. It remains a conflict lead, not an implemented judgment.
Timing samples are descriptive local measurements including startup, dictionary lookup and JSONL output, not statistical equivalence or universal throughput evidence.
